sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/agent_launcher.rs
sources.finding: 16 CLI launchers. Claude/Codex structured state;9 session-reader/resume types; last-answer parser and programmed interrupt only Claude. Hook/process-only integrations differ.

sources.title: Splitlane crates/splitlane-config/src/schema.rs
sources.finding: Saved projects/surfaces/session IDs/opened_by/worktree/layout/config; no native task/epic/backlog/requirements, role directory, scheduled-job or dollar-budget object.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/project/mod.rs
sources.finding: Stable restored IDs and bounded restoration:256threads/project,2048total,512chats. Thread state belongs to launched conversation rather than separate task.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/app/orchestration.rs
sources.locator: may_open; may_write; may_close; opening_prompt_step; inherit callers
sources.finding: Eight descendants shared across two levels. Caller-owned subtree operations; human-session driving asks/revokes; waiting human prompt blocks pane/keyholder writes. Opted-in outside scripting gate differs. Close own child with in-flight turn requires stop_turn. Opening prompt30s readiness bound.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/caller.rs
sources.finding: IPC peer PID/start and process ancestry identify pane caller. Codex special path checks executable basename and caller-supplied session ID; same-user hostile process can mimic basename, so not OS security isolation.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/app/ipc_handler.rs
sources.finding: Local surface/workspace/read/write/config actions; config watcher rebuilds telemetry and deactivates old handles. Persistent config access differs from a dedicated in-app telemetry UI.

sources.title: Splitlane crates/splitlane-mcp/src/tools.rs
sources.finding: Read-only list/read/search panes.200line default,4000lines/1000matches caps, untrusted output marker. Workspace env default; absent env falls back all, explicit all/global opt-in.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/workspace/worktree.rs
sources.finding: Human-session branch from HEAD; ten ports probed/reconciled; copy ignored .env*, local instructions and .worktreeinclude best-effort incl symlinks. Setup shell300s bound, failure nonfatal. No OS/network sandbox.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/app/session_worktree.rs
sources.finding: Git projects default own worktree for human-created sessions; children inherit opener cwd. Project switch disables. Setup runs alongside agent, not a readiness gate; worktree failure row requires choosing no-branch fallback.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/workspace/session_branch.rs
sources.finding: Deliberate discard saves Git tree/ref with changed ignored files before forced worktree and branch removal; snapshot refs pruned after30days. Not runtime or external-service rollback.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/terminal/host_session.rs
sources.finding: Host-owned shell survives window on supported macOS/Linux build, bounded queues and replay, explicit lost-connection notice. Closing pane terminates; host/machine death loses process, conversation resume separate.

sources.title: Splitlane crates/splitlane-host/src/server.rs
sources.finding: Local Unix host processes bounded connections, sessions and stream buffers; no managed cloud/SSH host fleet or automatic CPU/RAM task scheduler.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/app/session.rs
sources.finding: Sequence/debounced save, blocking quit save, migration backup, corruption backup max5 then empty-state fallback. Not lossless state claim.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/app/command_palette/history.rs
sources.finding: Reads per-agent history across open projects, sorts last activity and async prompt lookup; no separate issue tracker/search index.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/orchestration_journal.rs
sources.finding: Local JSONL handoff journal includes IDs/event/time/prompt length, not prompt text;2MiB rotation two files, mutable by local owner.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/diff/view/review.rs
sources.finding: Diff-column review starts selected CLI terminal(s), cwd-pinned prompt prefill without Enter for human submission; second opinion framing, refuses rerun until active review terminals closed.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/diff/view/attribution.rs
sources.finding: Matched session/model/token usage yields per-column and visible-worktree estimate; unknown models omit cost, no invoice reconciliation.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/pricing.rs
sources.finding: Embedded2026-08-15 model-family substring price table estimates input/output/cache costs; no fresh remote rate lookup, unpriced returns None.

sources.title: Splitlane crates/splitlane-telemetry/src/client.rs
sources.finding: Desktop PostHog only Some(true) config without SPLITLANE_NO_TELEMETRY/DO_NOT_TRACK/NO_TELEMETRY. Null/default no events. Opt-out deactivates old handle and drops queued events; build API key required for useful collection.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/app/telemetry_events.rs
sources.finding: Opted-in lifecycle OS/arch/version/install/duration, update funnel/error category and corruption file size/age/backup bool. No path/prompt/content in these event payloads.

sources.title: Splitlane crates/splitlane-remote/src/channel.rs
sources.finding: Per-connection salts, HKDF-SHA256 directional AES256GCM and counters bind messages to device keys/room/transcript; code inspection not cryptographic audit.

sources.title: Splitlane crates/splitlane-remote/src/pairing.rs
sources.finding: Random expiring QR fragment secret and device-key handshake; derived relay join token, confirmation code binds pairing. QR alone not final authorization.

sources.title: Splitlane src-app/src/remote/store.rs
sources.finding: Device pairing records/reply permissions removable, local private key raw file with0600 Unix creation/atomic write, user-profile Windows. Not universally OS-keystore encrypted.

sources.title: Splitlane relay/src/index.js
sources.finding: Cloudflare relay forwards ciphertext; stores join-token hash/last joined and expires inactive rooms180days,64KiBframes/two phone connections/20fps100burst. IP used for connection/claim limiter; no configured limiter means unlimited. Logs event categories, not room/address.

sources.title: Splitlane web/package.json
sources.finding: Phone is installable browser web app, not native iOS/Android client; same repository holds frontend and relay.

sources.title: Splitlane scripts/record-demo/record.sh
sources.finding: Vendor recording pipeline launches real app/agent sessions on ledger sample, waits for states and marks screenshot positions; no independent observed benchmark implied.

sources.finding: Native diff view switches split to unified below estimated360pixels per visible column. Base selector handles Escape and Enter; these controls establish partial keyboard/layout support without a usability result.
